title: Schwelle / header specimen
slide_intent: Make a simple progression distinctive so the viewer can recognize an identity element without text.
strategic_value: A thin-to-thick red bar sequence can provide DB with a compact visual signature.
demonstration: A centered horizontal sequence of red bars grows in width across a dark field.
practical_value: Inspect the progression as a standalone shape before judging its use with other elements.

content_islands.name: Bar sequence
content_islands.spec: Center the red progression with generous dark space around it.

reference_purposes.Expression: The standalone red bars increase in width from left to right.
